prompt:
A sprite sheet of 15 separate props for a top-down pixel-art JRPG, drawn from the classic 3/4 top-down RPG angle (you see the top surface and the front face; objects stand upright, feet/base at the bottom). Arrange them in a 3 x 5 grid in reading order (left to right, top to bottom), with wide empty space between them; every prop is fully separate, none touching or overlapping, nothing cut off by the image edge. The props, in order: 1) dead charred tree; 2) small charred stump; 3) steaming ground vent; 4) sharp obsidian shard cluster; 5) cooled lava rock; 6) hot spring pool with stone rim; 7) iron brazier (unlit); 8) arena banner on a pole (red cloth, no letters); 9) stone phoenix statue; 10) pile of volcanic rocks; 11) sulphur crystal cluster; 12) rope barrier post; 13) wooden weapon rack; 14) clay water urn; 15) ash-covered bush.
Scale: trees are about 60-70 art pixels tall, small items about 16-24 art pixels; each art pixel is about 6x6 image pixels.
Premium modern hi-bit 2D pixel art ("HD pixel art" JRPG look), hand-placed pixels. Every art pixel is a crisp square of the same size across the whole image (about 8x8 image pixels per art pixel). No anti-aliasing, no blur, no soft brushes, no photographic texture, no noise, no dithering checkerboards. Clusters of 3-10 pixels with clear shapes. Hue-shifted colour ramps: shadows lean toward purple/red and are more saturated, highlights lean toward warm yellow. 4-6 shades per material, rich but earthy, worn and lived-in.
Lighting: neutral, soft, even light from the upper left, like a calm overcast evening; NO cast shadows, NO night darkness, NO light sources, NO glow, NO lamp light pools, NO vignette. (The game engine adds the night lighting on top later, so this must be the clean base colours.)
Background: fully transparent. No ground under the props, no drop shadows, no text, no labels, no numbers.
revised_prompt: Create one sprite sheet PNG with fully transparent alpha background, 3 COLUMNS x 5 ROWS, 15 independent top-down 3/4 view pixel-art JRPG props in exact reading order, generous transparent gaps between every sprite, no overlap and no clipping. Row 1: (1) dead charred upright tree with bare branches, (2) small charred stump, (3) steaming ground vent. Row 2: (4) sharp black obsidian shard cluster, (5) cooled lava rock, (6) hot spring pool with stone rim. Row 3: (7) unlit empty iron brazier, (8) arena banner on pole, plain red cloth with NO symbols or lettering, (9) stone phoenix statue. Row 4: (10) pile of volcanic rocks, (11) sulphur crystal cluster, (12) rope barrier post. Row 5: (13) wooden weapon rack, (14) clay water urn, (15) ash-covered bush. Classic three-quarter top-down RPG prop viewpoint: top surfaces and front faces clearly visible, upright props' bases toward bottom. Consistent relative size: tree 60–70 ART pixels tall, little props 16–24 ART pixels tall; one art pixel a uniform crisp square ~6–8 screen pixels. Large spacious canvas as needed for this scale and grid. Premium modern HD pixel art, hand-placed exact grid-aligned square pixels, clusters of 3–10 pixels, sharply pixelated outlines and hard color boundaries, no smoothing, no antialiasing, blur, brushes, noise, dithering, or photographic textures. Cohesive earthy rich worn palette, 4–6 shades per material, purple/reddish saturated shadows, warm yellow highlights. Neutral soft even upper-left overcast lighting ONLY; no cast shadows, no glow or light emissions, no nighttime lighting, no vignette. Transparent emptiness everywhere except the individual sprites: absolutely no ground tiles, pedestal, drop shadows, typography, labels, numbers, borders or gridlines.
